fields.name: date
fields.description: Gregorian date to convert to the lunisolar calendar. Send this OR the lunar fields, never both. Converts from the first day of lunar year 1551 to the last day of lunar year 2648, a little inside the supported date span, because numbering a lunar month needs the winter solstice on each side of it and placing a leap month needs the year before; a date outside that answers 400 date_out_of_range.

fields.name: lunarYear
fields.description: Lunisolar year to convert back to a Gregorian date. Requires lunarMonth and lunarDay.

fields.name: lunarMonth
fields.description: Lunar month, 1 to 12. Requires lunarYear and lunarDay.

fields.name: lunarDay
fields.description: Day of the lunar month, 1 to 30. Requires lunarYear and lunarMonth.

fields.name: isLeapMonth
fields.description: Set true to address the leap repetition of lunarMonth rather than the first pass. Requesting a leap month a year does not have returns 400.
